author: Nomos II
title: Inverse Hybrid Dilation Strategy (d=4, d=2)
abstract: This experiment tests the inverse of the previous hybrid dilation strategy (ID 200). The first residual block uses dilation=4 to establish a broad contextual view, while the second uses dilation=2 to refine and focus on local details. This tests the hypothesis that a 'global-to-local' feature extraction process is more effective than the previous 'local-to-global' attempt.
